::: {#def-network-values .theorem}
## Network values

The sub-vector of some $\mathbf X \in \{0,1\}^n$ whose entries belong to nodes in the [neighborhood](#def-neighborhood) of $i$ in [graph](#def-graph) $\mathscr{G} = (\mathcal{N}, \psi)$.

$$
\mathbf X_{\mathcal N_i}=\big(X_j\big)_{j\in \mathcal N_i}
$$
:::
